nom: Vichy Normaderm S.O.S Acne Rescue Spot Corrector

segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin overwhelmingly report no burning, irritation or reaction from this product, often contrasting it with harsher acne treatments (benzoyl peroxide, salicylic acid) that irritated them in the past, and many still saw blemishes reduced quickly.
segments.dry: Reviewers who describe dry or dry-prone skin mostly report the product did not add dryness — a relief compared with other spot treatments — though one reviewer with already very dry winter skin noticed a bit more dryness.
segments.oily: The reviewers with oily skin report it worked well on their pimples and blackheads without extra issues, in one case despite being allergic to sulfur.
segments.combination: The one reviewer with combination skin reports it cleared her acne and marks within two weeks.

concerns.blemishes: The large majority report blemishes visibly shrinking or clearing within one night to a few days, including cystic, hormonal and mask-related (maskne) acne. A few reviewers instead saw no improvement at all after weeks of use, and several note it works better on spots that are already forming or healing than on brand-new or already-popped pimples.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers highlight that the product did not dry out their skin, a point of relief given past experience with over-drying acne treatments. A few report some dryness, either around the treated spot with repeated reapplication on the same blemish or generally during winter.
concerns.redness: Many reviewers report visibly reduced redness and swelling around blemishes, sometimes within a day. A few say the redness only partially faded rather than disappearing completely.
concerns.spots: Reviewers using it as an early intervention say it kept pustules from bursting or scarring, and several report faster fading of post-acne marks and old acne spots; no reviewer reports spots or marks getting worse.

aspects.libelle: Does not bleach fabric like benzoyl peroxide
Small amount lasts a long time

extraits.titre: Reduces blemishes quickly but strong smell
extraits.texte: I was given the Vichy Normaderm S.O.S. Acne Rescue Spot Corrector from the Stellar Product Testing Panel and was excited to try it. I'm 39 and yet still have quite a few breakouts, especially with all the mask wearing that's happening these days. I was glad to see that it has dermatologist-grade active ingredients. I used it once a day as there was a caution on the instructions that it could be irritating or over-drying and since I have sensitive skin, I was careful. I found that it did not over-dry my skin or irritate it which was great. It did a good job of reducing my blemishes quickly and I liked that it didn't lead to discoloration or bleaching of my pillowcase like some other acne products I've used. The one drawback is that it does have a strong smell of sulphur, so much so, that I had to stop using it around my nose where I often have breakouts. I think this is a high-quality product and works well to reduce acne but may not be as good of a choice for those of us with sensitive noses.

I'm luckily having a good stretch of skin (thank you pregnancy), but I have the occasional maskne flare up. When a patch seems to be breaking through, I apply the Vichy cream at night and it's like it wasn't even there in the morning. My skin did appear a bit dried out, but as it's winter in the Midwest my skin is super dry anyway. This cream did the trick amazingly without any crazy reactions. It's so nice knowing I have a tool to stop breakouts before they become out of control! I received this as a part of the Stellar Product Testing Panel (and I'm SO glad I did).

I bought this about 1 week ago and I already see results! I put this on my pimples and they are visibly reduced in 2 days . I do have very oily skin and get random pimples but they always come in 5 or 6 at a time . I put this spot treatment on them and by the next morning they are drying out and going down. I am 34 years old and this stuff works better than anything I have ever tried in my life ! I think it's bc of the sulfur that's in it . We have a place where I live and there is a river with sulfur in it and every time I went there my face would clear up so I am assuming that is the ingredient in this stuff that makes it work so well! I will always continue to buy this stuff !! It's a miracle treatment!

First I have very oily skin & large pores since I was a preteen. I'm now in my early 40s. I have battled acne all my life until around my mid 30s. The oil & pores haven't changed, just alot less acne. I get the occasional big one, & some small ones now & again. This stuff works wonders for me. I can't even belive it. I've tried so many products over the years & this by far works like a charm. Now I am allergic to sulfur.. so why did I even try it? Why not, my acne has done horrible nasty messes toy skin so it can't be much worsen right. So I tried it one 1 zit at first just to see. Bam it was gone the next day. I can say however for me I can't put it on the same zit more then twice in a row or my skin will be super dry around it. But by then my zit is already gone & healing. I had never heard of sulfur acne medicine before so I was astonished & wish I had had this back when I was younger & needed more. It may not work for everyone, but it was a win for me.
Cleared up my acne and marks within two weeks , I have extremely happy with this product range. It has been hard to find a product for my skin type as it is combination and sensitive.

I am very picky when it comes to my skincare, so when I received this little green tube from the Stellar Product Testing Panel, I was nervous. My skin can be unpredictable. At 31, I still struggle with acne on occasion. During the winter, redness and dry patches are my worst enemies. So I have my tried and true team of toner, serums, hyaluronic acid, moisturizer and my beloved retinol to keep my skin happy. But I don't have a spot treatment. They usually fail me—too harsh, leading to drying/peeling and irritation which inevitably leads to another breakout....exactly what I was trying to get rid of! Vichy Normaderm S.O.S. Acne Rescue Spot Corrector has done none of that for me, thankfully! I've had the opportunity to use it a couple of times now, and I've been pleasantly surprised! My sensitive skin has not reacted, at all, no matter how often I apply it (it recommends 1-3 times per day, but beginning with once per day and moving up to avoid any dryness). A very tiny dab of it goes a long way, and I love that the tube is made specifically to only dispense a teeny amount. Though it is a sulfur based spot treatment, it does not smell strongly of sulfur. One of the blemishes I used it on happened to be on the tip of my nose (thanks maskne....) and I did not find the smell at all unpleasant. I received this product through the Stellar Product Testing Panel, and couldn't be happier! I struggle with blackheads on my nose, and occasional red spots through a very oily t-zone, but the rest of my skin is dry. This product was amazing on both zones of my face, and got the job done, fast! I've tried many things on my nose, and it either doesn't work, or works but is so irritating I look like Rudolph after I use it. The first (and best) test was using it on my nose. I applied it before bed, and the next morning I already noticed a difference in the size of my pores and the amount of blackheads. After a week, my nose looked better than it ever has! And best of all, no red nose, irritation or tight feeling with my skin. I love the sulfur/niacinamide combination over salicylic acid, the sulfur does an amazing job of cleaning out my problem areas, while the niacinamide helps with the skin recovery. I use it every day and have not suffered from irritation. I plan on scaling back use now that my blackheads are under control, but will still use it to maintain the results.
